meta.name: vat-summary
meta.description: Produce a VAT / sales-tax summary for a period from a Well workspace's posted ledger. Use when the user asks for a VAT return, VAT summary, sales tax owed, output vs input VAT, or tax declaration figures for a period.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从记账数据生成增值税汇总报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每月需要从账套提取增值税数据
copy.tagline_en: Generate VAT summary reports from posted ledger data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract VAT figures from your accounting ledger each period

howto.what: Claude会根据已过账的账簿数据，生成指定期间的增值税/销售税摘要，包括按税率分组的销项税、进项税以及净应缴税额。如果期间账簿未关闭，会先提示未关闭。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成增值税申报、摘要、销售税欠款或某期间的税务数据时触发。

say.text: 生成今年第一季度的增值税申报表。
say.note: Claude会从账簿中提取数据并汇总。

say.text: 计算上个月的销项税和进项税。
say.note: Claude会按税率分组显示明细。

say.text: 显示当前期间的净应缴增值税。
say.note: Claude会输出净额并标注账簿状态。

howto.what_en: Claude produces a VAT/sales-tax summary for a given period from the posted ledger, showing output VAT by rate, input VAT by rate, and net VAT due. It warns if the period's books are not yet closed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a VAT return, VAT summary, sales tax owed, output vs input VAT, or tax declaration figures for a period.

say_en.text: Generate the VAT return for Q1 this year.
say_en.note: Claude will extract data from the ledger and aggregate.

say_en.text: Calculate output and input VAT for last month.
say_en.note: Claude will show breakdown by rate.

say_en.text: Show the net VAT due for the current period.
say_en.note: Claude will output the net amount and indicate book status.
